Market today:
Cautious mood. Rising Treasury yields, hitting 19-year highs, are the main driver, fueled by inflation fears and U.S.-Iran tensions. This directly hurts your tech/chip growth names by making future earnings less valuable.

Your holdings:
SOXL is a major concern, down -40.46% and leveraged. SPAL, a new leveraged ETF, is also deeply in the red at -39.68%. Both are highly sensitive to market shifts and decay. Your SMH position is also down -6.65%. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on Treasury yields and any escalation in U.S.-Iran tensions.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management and protect capital, especially with your leveraged positions.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL given its deep -40.46% loss and leveraged nature, especially with rising yields.
Review SPAL, a new leveraged position down -39.68%, as margin amplifies these drops and decay is a factor.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The macro environment doesn't support new long positions on margin.
